lines.learner: 인천공항에 가려고 해요. 빨리 가 주세요.
lines.en: I'm going to Incheon Airport. Please go fast.
lines.roman: incheongonghange garyeogo haeyo. ppalli ga juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. What time does your plane leave?

lines.en: How long does it take from here to the airport?

lines.beaver: 한 시간쯤 걸려요. 이 시간에는 길이 막혀요.
lines.beaver_en: About an hour. The roads are jammed at this time.
lines.beaver_roman: han sigan jjeum geollyeoyo. i siganeneun giri makyeoyo.
lines.en: Really? Won't I be late for my flight?

lines.beaver_en: Okay, I'll try to go fast.
lines.en: Thank you. What time will we arrive?

lines.beaver: 걱정 마세요. 저는 이십 년 동안 운전했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Don't worry. I've driven for twenty years.
lines.beaver_roman: geokjeong maseyo. jeoneun isim nyeon dongan unjeonhaesseoyo.
lines.learner: 와, 저는 자동차 운전을 못 해요.
lines.en: Wow, I can't drive a car.

lines.beaver_en: Then what do you usually take?
lines.learner: 보통 자전거를 타요. 지하철도 자주 타요.
lines.en: I usually ride a bike. I often take the subway too.
lines.roman: botong jajeongeoreul tayo. jihacheoldo jaju tayo.

lines.learner: 제주도에 가요. 다음에는 배를 타려고 해요.
lines.en: I'm going to Jeju. Next time I plan to take a ship.
lines.roman: jejudoe gayo. daeumeneun baereul taryeogo haeyo.

lines.beaver: 공항에 다 왔어요. 요금은 오만 사천 원이에요.
lines.beaver_en: We're at the airport. That's 54,000 won.
lines.beaver_roman: gonghange da wasseoyo. yogeumeun oman sacheon wonieyo.
lines.en: Here you go. Thank you. Goodbye.
